snippet.title: Official Snapimals: Discover and Snap Amazing Animals (by BebopBee, Inc) Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Snapimals: Discover and Snap Amazing Animals by BebopBee, Inc (iOS/Android)

"Snapimals is the Pokémon Game the Rest of Us Have Been Waiting For - Everything about Snapimals oozes with charm. It’s a simply feel good game, obviously built with a lot of heart, and has already stolen ours" - Jillian Werner, Gamezebo

"I'm addicted to this amazing game. Reminds me of Pokemon Snap, only better" - LoverOfGames_007

Discover incredible animals, take pictures, and build the greatest museum on earth!

Join The Captain and venture to the ends of the world to photograph the rarest, funniest, and wildest animals ever spotted!

* EXPLORE distant exotic lands
* SNAP pictures of amazing animals
* BUILD the greatest museum on earth

FEATURES
* Live the Moment: Experience a vibrant world through the lens of your trusty camera
* Go Wild: Venture among the animals and see what they really do when nobody's watching
* Craft your World: Build out your museum and have visitors venture from all over the globe to experience your creation
* Interact with Animals - Toss goof-balls and play a harmonica to unlock and discover your beloved animals' quirky behaviors, especially those of Rare and Legendary ones
* Upgrade your Camera - Zoom in to get up close and personal with the fascinating animals. Special and intuitive 3D Touch controls for Zoom and 'Peek and Pop' for iPhone 6s
* Captain’s Pics - Snap and Collect all the pics for the Captain’s Collection

Most recent update:
* Feature - 3D Touch for an amazing Zoom and 'Peek and Pop' experience
* Feature - Visitors now leave you Gifts boxes
* New Feedback UI for Community Love
* New UI enhancements - ZOOM Lens and # Pics slotted on HUD

iTunes Store Page:

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/snapimals-discover-snap-amazing/id1009979707?mt=8
